csv_project_name: Design for Long Acre IRA Roof Replacement
csv_agency: Finger Lakes Development Disabilities Service Ofc
csv_scope_of_work: The Design Vendor shall provide all labor and materials necessary to complete a fully comprehensive drawing design and specification generation of the services required in a professional manner. The first submission of the design will be due within 15 days of the purchase order issue. The intention of this design is to replace the Roof, Missing soffits, Rafter tails, fascia boards, gutters and downspouts. Consideration of the warranty as it relates to the ventilation aspects of the building should be included. SCOPE OF WORK includes, but is not necessarily limited to the following: A. Design Services: 1. Provide a Pre-Bid estimate of the cost of the project based on current pricing. 2. Provide a specification for the asbestos abatement work which must remain watertight until the roof can be replaced. 3. Provide a design for the replacement of the roof 4. Drawing Designs and Specifications are to be in accordance with: a. Code rule 56 b. 14 NYCRR 635, Subpart 635-7 c. 19 NYCRR 1201 and 1204. d. OPWDD Specifications, e. NFPA (NFPA 101 - Life Safety Code) f. NYS Uniform Building Code, g. NYS Environmental and Energy Code Regulation Compliance. h. NFPA 101A Guide on Alternative Approaches to Life Safety. 5. Product Specification Data, Construction details, material descriptions, dimensions, profiles, finishes, schematics, and cut sheets. 6. Minimum requirements: 30-year warranty and glass fiber reinforced asphalt shingles with algae resistance. No asbestos containing materials are to be used. All primary roofing products will be provided by a single manufacturer. . 7. All Design and Specification documents shall be provided on Adobe (.pdf) 8. Document Submissions to be provided to OPWDD Point of Contact at routine Intervals: a. 90% Completion (Issued for Permitting- signed and stamped), b. 100% Completion (approved for construction) Facility: Long Acre Rd IRA Facility Address: 198 Long Acre Rd, Rochester, 14621 Point of Contact: Geoffrey Miller Contact Phone Number: 315 604 1430 Project Title: Long acre Roof Design Summary of Work: Design the roof replacement Page 2 of 2 9. Upon completion, after the job is accepted for construction, Design Vendor shall provide (2) sets of 24 x 36 blueprints to the project manager listed above. 10. This agency is self-permitting. 11. Generalized Statements required by OPWDD for protection of Service Recipients and Operations as the property will be occupied during construction, on a case-by-case basis
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Structural Engineering

title: Design for Long Acre IRA Roof Replacement
short_description: Design services for replacing an occupied facility's roof and related exterior components.
project_location: 198 Long Acre Rd, Rochester, NY 14621, USA
project_scope: Design and specification services for replacement of the existing roof at the Long Acre Rd IRA facility, including missing soffits, rafter tails, fascia boards, gutters, and downspouts. The design must address ventilation in relation to warranty requirements, include asbestos abatement specifications to keep the building watertight until replacement, and provide product data, construction details, material descriptions, dimensions, profiles, finishes, schematics, and cut sheets. Minimum roofing requirements include a 30-year warranty and glass fiber reinforced asphalt shingles with algae resistance. The occupied facility remains in operation during construction.
services: Architectural and structural design services for roof replacement; preparation of drawings and specifications; pre-bid cost estimate; asbestos abatement specification; permitting-stage 90% signed and stamped submission; 100% construction-ready documents; blueprint delivery after acceptance for construction.
relevance_explanation:
- Small building maintenance project focused on roof replacement.
- No long-span, bridge, special structure, or architecturally demanding structural scope indicated.
- Structural engineering is listed, but the task is primarily conventional building envelope design.
- Limited strategic relevance for sbp compared with bridges, stadiums, or complex lightweight structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender documents. The scope is a roof replacement with soffits, fascia, gutters, downspouts, and asbestos abatement specification for an occupied facility, but no roof area, building size, or budget is provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No design fee or budget for professional services is stated in the tender documents.
references_qualifications: No explicit reference requirements are stated in the provided text. The design must comply with Code Rule 56, 14 NYCRR 635 Subpart 635-7, 19 NYCRR 1201 and 1204, OPWDD specifications, NFPA 101, NYS Uniform Building Code, NYS Environmental and Energy Code, and NFPA 101A. Signed and stamped permitting documents are required.

Disciplines requested include Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, and Structural Engineering.
